item.title: Opening Post
item.content:encoded:
This is the hub page for my five part tale series that features TwistedGears's character, Agent Navarro.

I appreciate everyone that helped in the editing of this series, especially Decibelle, kaktus, Goomy.

Extra special thanks to TwistedGears for not only letting me use his character a bunch, but write a bunch of backstory for him. He really is one of my favorite characters on the site, and giving my own take on him was a lot of fun.

Hope you enjoy the series.

Mmmm'yep.
